We need their support.|Breha Organa|audio=Breha-Sister.flac|}} [[Duchess]] '''Celly Organa''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] member of the [[House of Organa]] of the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]]. In [[9 BBY]], she visited the family of her sister, [[Queen]] [[Breha Organa]] of Alderaan, along with her own family: her [[Marriage|husband]] [[Kayo Organa|Kayo]], son [[Niano Organa|Niano]], and her two [[Unidentified Organa child 1|other]] [[Unidentified Organa child 2|children]]. While visiting, Celly and family attended a meal at the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan]] and discussed [[politics]] with Breha and her husband, [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], whose daughter, [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]], had received many lessons in manners and rhetoric from her aunts, much to her chagrin. ==Biography== {{Quote|There are still some issues we need to address. Slave labor, taxation of the Outer Rim…''"
"''I didn't come here to end slavery, Bail. I came to eat your food.|Bail and Kayo Organa, with Breha and Celly Organa listening|audio=Bail-Kayo.flac|}} Celly Organa was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[duchess]] of the [[Elder Houses]]' [[House of Organa]], the [[Alderaanian monarchy|royal family]] of her [[homeworld]], the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]]. She was the sister of [[Queen]] [[Breha Organa]], [[Marriage|married]] to Duke [[Kayo Organa]], and [[Parent|mother]] of [[Niano Organa]] and two [[Unidentified Organa child 1|other]] [[Unidentified Organa child 2|children]]. She and her family moved to Kayo's home [[city]] of [[Hallyn]], understanding that the [[throne]] would go to a child of Breha's and that [[Aldera]]—Alderaan's [[capital]]—was already well represented by the Organa family. Breha's daugher, [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]], was tutored from a young age by her aunts in [[Diplomat|diplomacy]] and studied [[politics]], manners, and rhetoric,''[[Princess Leia: Royal Rebel]]'' lessons which Leia felt were "ruthless" and forced her to be a "simpering princess."''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'' During her youth, Leia's aunts wished for her to be wedded advantageously, though the princess was not fond of the idea herself.''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]'' [[File:KayoCelly-PartI.png|thumb|right|300px|Celly (left) and Kayo Organa at the Royal Palace of Alderaan]] In [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|I}} Organa and her family visited Breha and her family: [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail]] and Leia Organa. Breha and Bail needed Celly's family's support, which Breha told who she thought was Leia but was actually Leia's [[handmaiden]] [[Agira]] in disguise. Celly and her family greeted Breha, Bail, and Leia at a dock and then made their way to a meal at the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan]], where Celly and her husband discussed [[The galaxy|galactic]] politics with Breha and Bail. The senator attempted to discuss [[slavery]] and the [[Galactic Empire|Empire's]] taxation of the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]], but Kayo made a joke about preferring to eat Bail's [[Foodstuff|food]] than trying to end slavery, which Celly laughed at. In order to keep the conversation civil, Breha offered Bail a drink. Leia once escaped to a [[circus]] to avoid her aunts' lessons. Her aunts also pushed back when Leia wanted to join the [[Galactic Senate]], and although she did not like to admit it, she was grateful that the public-speaking lessons her aunts had given her helped her speeches later in life. While Leia's aunts planned what her [[hair]]style should be on her first visit to the capital planet [[Coruscant]], Leia thought about what issues to tell [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] to his face; however, she was too intimidated and curtsied automatically due to her aunts' intense manners training. Once Leia turned sixteen, her aunts agreed that self-defense should become part of her training, which helped Leia bear her normal lessons later in the [[Standard day|day]]. [[Standard year|Years]] after Alderaan's [[Destruction of Alderaan|destruction]], in [[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates ''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]'' to [[4 ABY]]. Leia thought about her aunts' wishes regarding her future marriage as she prepared to marry [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[General]] [[Han Solo]]. ==Personality and traits== Celly and her husband enjoyed living lavishly rather than engaging in the political world. She had [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, dark hair, and fair skin. ==Equipment== The duchess wore beige [[clothing]] that had a multicolored design over her chest and shoulders. The garb also had red down the middle of her front that went around her neck as well. Upon arrival to visit her sister's family, she wore an additional red sash. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Celly_Organa.png|thumb|right|200px|Celly Organa, as depicted in the Legends continuity]] In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the aunts of Leia Organa were collectively mentioned in the [[2015]] junior novel ''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]'', written by [[Cecil Castellucci]] and [[Jason Fry]]. None were identified by name, however,''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]'' until Celly Organa first appeared in "[[Part I]]," the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', which premiered on [[May 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|date=2022-05-27|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}} While unnamed in the episode, she was identified as "Duchess Celly Organa" in the credits and was portrayed by [[Roberta Sparta]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Celly Organa/Legends|Celly Organa]] was first mentioned in the [[1995]] novel [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']], written by [[Barbara Hambly]].[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] She later made her first appearance in "[[The Princess Leia Diaries]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] published in ''[[Star Wars Tales]]''{{'}} [[Star Wars Tales 11|eleventh issue]]. The story was written by [[Jason Hall]], illustrated by [[Chris Brunner]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]{{Tales|11|The Princess Leia Diaries}} on [[March 20]], [[2002]].{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53989/star_wars_tales_1999_11|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) #11}} In Legends, Celly was one of Bail Organa's sisters instead of Breha's as she is in the new canon. The change was made since ''Star Wars'' creator [[George Lucas]]'s [[1977]] notes on [[Alderaanian]] culture establish that the royal lineage comes from the queen's side.{{SW|url=obi-wan-kenobi-part-i-trivia-gallery|text=Part I Trivia Gallery | Obi-Wan Kenobi}} {{C|Slide 8}} ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part I}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 1|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 1]] *''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]'' {{Ab|A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy (audiobook)}} {{1stm}} {{Imo}} *''[[Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure]]'' {{Ab|Moving Target: A Princess Leia Adventure (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} *''[[The Princess and the Scoundrel]]'' {{Ab|The Princess and the Scoundrel (audiobook)}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Celly Organa}} *''[[Princess Leia: Royal Rebel]]'' {{Imo}} *{{SW|url=series/obi-wan-kenobi/part-i-guide|text=Part I Episode Guide | Obi-Wan Kenobi}} *{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2023-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SDCC 2023: 10 Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}} *{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars Chrome Black|cardname=Roberta Sparta as Duchess Celly Organa}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{SW|url=news/dawn-of-rebellion|text=5 Behind-the-Pages Secrets of ''Star Wars:'' ''Dawn of Rebellion''}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Celly Organa |es=Celly Organa |fr=Celly Organa |ja=セリー・オーガナ |ka=სელი ორგანა |nl=Celly Organa |pl=Celly Organa |pt=Celly Organa |tr=Celly Organa }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Organa, Celly}} [[Category:Duchesses]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:House of Organa|Celly]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
